_about: Signatures and stamps on page 2, checked when the photo of page 2 is added in New Enrolment
(app/endorsements.py). The result is a note to the user: it never refuses a photo.
checks: what each box must have. needs: 'mark' = any signature or fingerprint;
'writing' = a name and/or a signature; 'name_signature' = a name and a signature (the reader
cannot tell a name from a signature: it looks for writing, and notes it when only one short
piece of writing is found); 'stamp' = an official stamp.
'numbers': the item number printed on the form; numbers_by_form gives other numbers for an edition.
boxes: where each box is on the reference page of each edition (x, y, width, height in pixels
of app/forms/<edition>/page_1.png), WITHOUT the printed title at the top of the box.
'rita' (item 69) is not checked, but a stamp in it must not be counted for its neighbours.
stamp_margin_mm: how far outside its box a stamp is still looked for (stamps are often put
half outside the box). A stamp is counted for the box nearest to its centre, so a stamp in
the next box is never counted twice.
stamp_min_mm: a stamp is at least this tall and this wide.
min_writing_mm2: less ink than this (square millimetres) in a box counts as nothing written.
Restart is not needed: this file is read each time.
